name: strongman apollons axle
description: Lifting a thick axle bar from the floor to overhead. The fat grip makes it a brutal test for hands, forearms and shoulders.
instructions: Stand over the thick axle with feet shoulder width apart and grip it firmly.
Pull it up the thighs with a flat back and clean it to your chest.
Dip and drive with your legs, pressing the axle overhead until your arms lock.
Bring it back down to your chest and then the floor with control.
